title: The World Economic Forum in Davos is now dominated by tech giants, whose interests shunt aside topics like climate change, as Trump and AI take center stage (Peter S. Goodman/New York Times)
summary: Peter S. Goodman / New York Times: The World Economic Forum in Davos is now dominated by tech giants, whose interests shunt aside topics like climate change, as Trump and AI take center stage — The World Economic Forum is now dominated by global technology companies whose interests shunt aside most others.
